question: Which set of bodily and expressive signs are being enumerated here as a cluster rather than as isolated and unrelated occurrences?
premises: Trembling and agitation are listed as a paired cluster of signs.
Speech and gesture are listed alongside leaping as further items.
Connectives mark a single enumeration rather than separate clauses.
inference: A cluster of signs—trembling, agitation, speech, gesture, and leaping—is enumerated together.
uncertainties: Order of causation between these signs cannot be determined from this verse alone.
plain_english: Trembling, agitation, and likewise speech, gesture, and leaping.
